## Changes

**`homeassistant/components/schlage/const.py`**
- Added `SERVICE_ADD_CODE = "add_code"`, `SERVICE_DELETE_CODE = "delete_code"`, `SERVICE_GET_CODES = "get_codes"`.

- Added `async_setup` that registers all three services as platform entity services for the `lock` domain via `service.async_register_platform_entity_service`.
- `add_code`'s schema validates `code` with `cv.matches_regex(r"^\d{4,8}$")` — rejecting non-numeric, too-short (<4), and too-long (>8) values at the schema layer.
- `get_codes` is registered with `supports_response=SupportsResponse.ONLY`.
- Added a `CONFIG_SCHEMA` (config-entry-only) as is standard for integrations with an `async_setup`.

**`homeassistant/components/schlage/lock.py`** — three methods on `SchlageLockEntity`:
- `add_code`: refreshes access codes (raises `schlage_refresh_failed` on `SchlageError`), then calls `add_access_code` with `AccessCode(name=name, code=code)` (raises `schlage_add_code_failed` on failure).
- `delete_code`: case-insensitive name match; returns silently when `access_codes` is `None`/empty or no match; only calls `.delete()` on the matching code; raises `schlage_delete_code_failed` on failure.
- `get_codes`: refreshes first (raises `schlage_refresh_failed`), returns a dict keyed by code ID with `name`/`code` fields, or `{}` when empty/`None`.

**`homeassistant/components/schlage/strings.json`**
- Added the required exception keys (`schlage_add_code_failed`, `schlage_delete_code_failed`, `schlage_name_exists` with `{name}` placeholder, `schlage_code_exists`) plus a `services` section describing the three services.

**`homeassistant/components/schlage/services.yaml`** (new)
- Service/field definitions per HA convention.
